issues.legal_issue: Whether the prosecution proved that the deceased was subjected to cruelty or harassment for or in connection with a dowry demand soon before her death, as required to raise the presumption of dowry death under Section 304B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 113B of the Indian Evidence Act.
Whether the evidence established cruelty within the meaning of Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Whether the appellant’s conviction and sentence under Sections 304B, 498A and 201 of the Indian Penal Code could be legally sustained.
